title: $t$-tone edge coloring of graphs
summary: In this paper, we introduce the notion of $t$-tone edge coloring. A $t$-tone edge $k$-coloring of a graph $G$ assigns to each edge of $G$ a set of $t$ distinct colors from $\{1,\dots,k\}$ such that any two edges at distance $d$ share fewer than $d$ common colors. The $t$-tone chromatic index of $G$, denoted by $τ'_t(G)$, is the minimum integer $k$ for which $G$ admits a $t$-tone edge $k$-coloring.
